<action type="say">
I can’t directly create or send email alerts myself, but you can set up a delay notification for this shipment in a couple of quick ways:

1) Through USPS tracking  
- Go to the USPS tracking page.  
- Enter tracking number: 94001118992234567890.  
- Look for options like “Text & Email Updates” or “Get Updates.”  
- Choose Email and enter: carmen.silva@rockymountainpolicy.org.  
- Select status changes you care about (e.g., “Expected Delivery Change,” “Out for Delivery,” “Delivered”).

2) Through the store’s order page  
- Open the store’s website and sign in (or use your order lookup link).  
- View order ODR-105234.  
- If there’s a “Track package” or “Delivery alerts” option, select Email and enter the same address.

If you’d like, paste the USPS tracking page URL or a screenshot of the options you see, and I’ll tell you exactly which buttons to click for your email alerts.</action>
